fields.label: Allowed Windows
fields.help: List of time windows during which practice runs are allowed, in the format `Day:HH:MM-Day:HH:MM` (e.g., `Mon:09:00-Mon:17:00`).

fields.label: Blocked Dates
fields.help: List of dates when practice runs should not be started, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`.

fields.label: Blocked Windows
fields.help: List of time windows during which practice runs should not be started, in the format `Day:HH:MM-Day:HH:MM` (e.g., `Mon:00:00-Mon:08:00`).

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Resource Arn
fields.help: The ARN of the managed resource to configure zonal autoshift for (e.g., an Application Load Balancer).

fields.label: Blocking Alarms
fields.help: List of CloudWatch alarms that can block practice runs when in alarm state.

fields.label: Outcome Alarms
fields.help: List of CloudWatch alarms monitored during practice runs.
